audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[N].side reads 'Skill' on all 7 rows while content.win[N] already says Nautilus for levels 1-5/1st item and Zilean for late (2+ items).
audit.why: win[N] and its grounded whys[] are already correct (Zilean has no early self-peel, but Chronoshift revives through the late-game pick your kit depends on); the full layer chart was never updated to agree.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0-5].side to Nautilus and phases[6].side to Zilean with matching ratings and shortened whys.

audit.why: Spikes correctly key level 2 (bait the double-bomb), level 6 (Depth Charge forces or picks around Chronoshift), first item (dive through the slow), and late (Chronoshift undoes the pick).

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Chronoshift's untargetability should be waited out rather than burst into, and that both Q's are competing displacement — neither is currently stated anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns has no digit.
audit.why: enemyKit R has the untargetable flag; both Q's carry the knockup flag, so whoever lands their own Q first wins the trade.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns to cite Time Bomb's real cooldown and clarify the single-bomb stun is not a threat.

edits.before: Auto-root the contacts — the passive snare makes every walk-up a trade you start.
edits.after: Zilean is immobile with no real self-peel — your passive punishes every early trade.

edits.before: Hook online: the lane's geometry answers to the anchor already.
edits.after: Bait his one stun, then hook a squishy target with no escape.

edits.before: Full kit: hook-auto-W-E chains a carry through your duo's full rotation.
edits.after: Your all-in overwhelms his one-trick double-bomb peel completely.

edits.before: Zone with anchor threat — their carry farms at the range your Q defines.
edits.after: Your engage keeps forcing his defensive cooldowns through levels 4-5.

edits.before: Depth Charge online — the point-click knockup chain cannot be bodied or dodged.
edits.after: Depth Charge either picks him outright, or baits and wastes his Chronoshift.

edits.before: First item: the chains harden and the shield trades bully.
edits.after: Tank items let you dive through his slow and land clean hooks.

edits.before: Late Naut starts everything: R the carry through the formation and anchor whatever peels.
edits.after: Chronoshift now revives a target through your Depth Charge lock, blunting the pick you rely on.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Every early trade is free — Zilean has no self-peel until his double-bomb stun lands, so force the fight.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Chasing a target Chronoshift already saved — the revive undoes the kill and you've spent your cooldowns.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. It writes your spacing rules. - W Titan's Wrath is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Zilean's Time Bomb (Q) is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s — his only stun needs a second bomb to detonate, so a single Q is not a threat. - Chronoshift undoes your kill; force it early or swap focus when it glows. - Spend your R on swing moments only.
